Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

A pharmacist follows labeling and applicable REMS for an eligible long-acting buprenorphine injection.
A pharmacy administers ceftriaxone intravenously using the circular’s IM authorization.
A trained pharmacist with current CPR administers an eligible single-dose LAI to an adult under a valid prescription and product requirements.
A certified technician uses this non-vaccine administration circular to give an adult patient a long-acting antipsychotic injection.

A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.
The parties terminate the collaboration without informing patients who still depend on its prescribing and monitoring.
A retail program applies the separate minor-contraception consent rule to remove CDTM’s adult-patient requirement.
A retail CDTM pharmacist receives the supervising physician’s patient-specific written referral and diagnosis information.

choices.text: A pharmacist obtains a new legally sufficient authorization when the requested change cannot be made under the permitted-change rules.
A pharmacist verifies the DEA check digit but does not check the prescriber’s current schedule authority when that authority is in doubt.
An authorized agent independently selects a different drug and dose while transmitting the practitioner’s order.
A pharmacist increases the quantity of a federally controlled prescription to match an insurance package size without discussing the change.
A pharmacy uses the hospital’s inpatient-order exception for a take-home discharge prescription.
